title: CoverLetterReview
description: Versioned scorecard emitted by the review-cover-letter skill. Findings are fix-ready: each fix_instruction is an imperative for a downstream rewriter. A check that could not be evaluated because an input was missing is reported with status 'unverifiable' — never omitted and never passed.

case_id.description: Optional id when run in batch mode. Must not encode personal data.

inputs_seen.description: Exactly what the reviewer was given. Never list an input that was not actually provided.

inputs_missing.description: Recommended inputs that were absent. Every entry here must be traceable to at least one finding with status 'unverifiable'.

detected_params.description: The parametric frame (rules.md section 0). A value that could not be inferred is 'unknown', and every rule gated on it is skipped rather than guessed.

locale_mode.description: Market/language tag such as ru_RU, en_US, en_UK_EU, or 'unknown'.

scores.description: Per-category roll-up. fail = a critical or high in the category; warn = only medium, or any unverifiable finding; pass = only low findings and nothing degraded. PD-* rolls up under honesty.

claim_audit.description: Every factual claim in the message, classified against the honesty boundary (rules.md section 6).

overall_verdict.description: block = any critical finding; revise = no critical but at least one high, at least one unverifiable, or three or more medium; send_ready = only low/medium polish, no unverifiable, and every recommended input present.

summary.description: One or two sentences: the decisive problems and the highest-leverage fix. Must name any missing input that limited the review.

fix_brief.description: Ordered must-fix imperatives (critical + high, most-blocking first) — ready to append to a rewriter prompt. Never contains rewritten letter text.

rule_id.description: Stable rule id from rules.md, e.g. INSTR-1, PROOF-2, HON-1. Project-specific rules use their own prefix.

status.description: unverifiable = the check could not be evaluated because an input was missing; carries severity 'high' and blocks send_ready without forcing block.

evidence.description: Verbatim offending span; "<absent>" when a required element is missing; "<whole message>" when the finding is about the message as a whole; "<not provided: cv>" style when the finding is unverifiable.

fix_instruction.description: Imperative for a rewriter: name the span and the target form. For an unverifiable finding, name the input that would settle it.

param.description: Optional: the detected parameter that triggered or escalated this rule, e.g. instruction_mode=keyword_gate.

note.description: Why this bucket: which source fact backs it, or what is missing.
